title: How to create live videos on >x<

runs: Go to your application or hardware settings and choose “Custom Streaming Server”
Select ">x<" from your pull down option to authenticate this encoder with your >x< account
Log in to your >x< account using the username and password for the account you wish to send the stream to and accept permissions
Start streaming your video.
Please Note: Every encoder is a little different so we advise that you reference the application’s manual if you have any questions.

q: When I go live on >x<, where does it go?

runs: Your live video can go anywhere that a post can go. This means that it’ll be searchable in the >x< app, on the >x< website, and it can be embedded on other websites just like any other post.

q: Can I make changes to my live video once it’s been broadcasted?

runs: In the >x< for iOS and Android apps, you can change the title, thumbnail image, and set a custom starting point after ending a broadcast. To get started, tap on the broadcast you’d like to edit. Tap on the overflow menu, then tap the
option. Once you make your changes you’ll be prompted to save.
Keep in mind that broadcast titles can be edited up to three times. Additionally, it will take up to 15 minutes for edits to appear in >x<.

q: Can I comment in a live video on >x<?

runs: Yes, you can comment and send hearts in any live video you’re watching on iOS, Android, and on the web. You can also interact with other members of the audience by tapping on a comment to view the account profile, respond to a comment, or block the account.

Hearts are how you share support and show your enthusiasm for a video. On iOS or Android, tap the screen to give the broadcaster a heart. On web, you can give hearts once you’re logged in by clicking the heart icon in the bottom right corner.

q: Can you remove someone from watching and commenting in a live video?

runs: When you block someone on >x< they can't watch or comment in your live video. If you want to stop someone from commenting in your live video, you can block them by tapping on their comment, selecting their profile, tapping the
icon, and then choosing
. The account will no longer see or participate in your live videos and they'll be blocked on >x<.
As a viewer, you can report comments that you find abusive or offensive by selecting the comment and choosing
. When you report a comment you'll no longer see messages from that commenter for the remainder of the live video. This will not, however, block the account on >x<.

q: Can I delete my live video?

runs: Yes, you can delete any of your posted videos at any time by deleting your post.

q: Can I go live if my posts are protected?

runs: You cannot go live from >x< if you have protected posts.

When you make your posts protected, after being public, your live videos will only be discoverable to your followers on >x<. You can delete previous live videos from >x< deleting the post with your live video.

q: Can viewers comment on my live video?

runs: Viewers can comment directly in live videos through >x<.

q: How do I find more live videos to watch?

runs: You can discover Live broadcasts on the >x< timeline when others share the live event. You can also click on the bell icon on a specific account profile you follow and you’ll get notified when they start their next broadcast.
